error.validation_failed: Some of the details you entered are not valid. Please check and try again.
error.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
error.conflict: That has already changed. Refresh and try again.
error.illegal_transition: That action is not possible at this stage of the job.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. We have been notified.
error.market_not_live: NINETY is not live in your area yet.
error.upstream_unavailable: A service we depend on is not responding. Please try again shortly.
error.payment_failed: Your card was not authorised. No money has been taken.
error.courier_unavailable: No driver is available right now. Our team is arranging one.
error.otp_invalid: That code is not correct. Please check and try again.
error.otp_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
error.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many incorrect codes. Request a new one.
error.token_invalid: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.role_not_permitted: This account cannot use that part of NINETY.
error.request_not_yours: That request belongs to another account.
error.offer_window_closed: The window for this job has passed. It is no longer open for quotes.
error.already_offered: You have already quoted on this job.
error.offer_not_available: That offer is no longer available. Please choose another.
error.supplier_not_active: This yard is not active. Contact NINETY support.
error.supplier_not_fanned_out: This job was not sent to you.
error.duplicate_request: You posted a very similar request a few minutes ago. Post it again anyway, or open the one you already have.
error.invalid_vehicle_identifier: That vehicle number does not look right for this country. You can enter the make, model and year instead.
error.media_too_large: That file is too large. Photos should be under {{megabytes}} MB.
error.media_type_not_allowed: Only photos and short videos can be uploaded.
error.dispute_counterparty_cannot_resolve: A dispute cannot be resolved by the other side of the order.
error.kyc_required_for_payout: Verification must be completed before a payout can be released.
error.price_out_of_range: That price does not look right. Please check it.

scrub.rejected: Your note could not be sent because it contains contact details.
scrub.phone: We removed nothing — we stopped the note. It contains what looks like a phone number.
scrub.email: It contains what looks like an email address.
scrub.url: It contains a web or app link.
scrub.handle: It contains a messaging app or social handle.
scrub.solicitation: It asks the buyer to make contact directly.
scrub.why: NINETY keeps both sides anonymous. That is what protects your next job from being taken off the platform — and it is why we pay you automatically and handle the delivery. Please remove the contact details and send the note again.

buyer.request_submitted: {{reference}} is out to {{count}} yards. Offers close at {{deadline}}.
buyer.offers_final: Offers are in for {{reference}}. {{count}} to choose from.
buyer.search_widened: Nobody has answered on {{reference}} yet, so we have widened the search to more yards and a larger area. We will tell you either way by {{deadline}}.
buyer.no_offers: We could not find {{part}} for your {{vehicle}} today. Nobody who stocks it had it on the shelf. We have logged it — if it comes in, we will tell you.
buyer.no_supply: No yard in your area breaks the {{vehicle}}, so we had nobody to ask for {{part}}. We have logged it.
buyer.payment_authorised: Payment of {{total}} is ring-fenced on your card for {{reference}}. It is only taken when the part arrives.
buyer.payment_failed: Your card was not authorised for {{reference}}. No money has been taken and your offers are still there — try another card or another offer.
buyer.courier_assigned: A driver is collecting your part for {{reference}}. Expected with you around {{eta}}.
buyer.courier_collected: Your part for {{reference}} has been collected and is on its way.
buyer.delivered: Your part for {{reference}} has been delivered. Tap to confirm, or tell us if something is wrong.
buyer.delivery_delayed: Traffic is holding up {{reference}}. The new expected time is {{eta}}. We are sorry — you are not being charged any more for it.
buyer.delivery_failed: We could not complete delivery of {{reference}}. The hold on your card has been released and nothing has been charged. Our team is on it.
buyer.courier_all_failed: No driver has accepted {{reference}} yet, so a member of our team is arranging one directly. New expected time {{eta}}. Nothing has been charged.
buyer.courier_failed_after_collection: Your part for {{reference}} has been collected but the delivery has run into a problem. It is safe, our team is tracking it, and we will call you within the hour.
buyer.auto_confirmed: {{reference}} was completed automatically after {{hours}} hours. Payment of {{total}} has been taken. If something was wrong, you can still raise it with us.
buyer.offer_withdrawn: One of the offers on {{reference}} was withdrawn by the yard. Your remaining offers are still open.
buyer.accepted_offer_withdrawn: The yard withdrew the offer you accepted on {{reference}}. Nothing has been charged and the hold is released — your other offers are open again.
buyer.request_expired: {{reference}} expired because no offer was chosen. Nothing was charged. You can post it again in one tap.
buyer.dispute_opened: We have opened a case on {{reference}}. Someone will come back to you within one working day.
buyer.dispute_resolved: Your case on {{reference}} has been resolved: {{resolution}}
buyer.refund_issued: {{amount}} has been refunded on {{reference}}. It normally shows on your statement within a few working days.

supplier.new_request: New job {{reference}} — {{part}} for a {{vehicle}}, {{distance}} away. {{minutes}} minutes to answer.
supplier.request_withdrawn: {{reference}} has been withdrawn. No action needed.
supplier.offer_accepted: You won {{reference}}. Your payout is {{payout}}. Pack it in NINETY packaging and nothing else.
supplier.offer_lost: {{reference}} went to another yard this time.
supplier.driver_eta: A driver is collecting {{reference}} at around {{eta}}.
supplier.payout_queued: {{payout}} for {{reference}} is queued for your next payout run.
supplier.dispute_opened: A case has been opened on {{reference}}. We will ask you for your side before anything is decided.
supplier.score_changed: Your score is now {{score}}. You rank {{rank}} in your city.
supplier.offline_not_penalised: Your terminal was offline when {{reference}} went out, so it has not counted against your response rate.
supplier.packaging_rule: Pack in NINETY packaging. No business cards, no invoices, no contact details in the parcel.

unhappy.supplier_withdrew_before_accept: A yard withdrew its offer before you chose. The rest are unaffected.
unhappy.duplicate_detected: This looks like a request you already posted {{minutes}} minutes ago. Posting it again will send it to the same yards a second time.
unhappy.buyer_cancelled_authorised: You cancelled {{reference}}. The hold on your card has been released — nothing was taken.
unhappy.buyer_cancelled_dispatched: You cancelled {{reference}} after a driver had collected it. We have released the hold and our team will contact you about the return.
unhappy.terminal_offline_at_fanout: Your terminal was offline when this job went out, so you did not miss it and it has not affected your score.

sla.public_promise: Offers in {{offersMinutes}} minutes. Delivered in {{deliveryMinutes}}, typically — up to {{peakHours}} hours in peak traffic.
